title: Quizr
description: This is a Plugin that i made to help myself study. I wanted to share this to help others!
body:
I made _Quizr_ to help myself study. It has worked phenomenally so now i'm releasing it to help others like myself!

___________________________________________________________________________________________

Commands:

/add <Question> | <Answer>

/remove <Question>

/quizsend <time> 

___________________________________________________________________________________________

Command Explanation:


/add: Add a question to your quizr

/remove: Remove a question from your quizr

/quizsend: Change how often your quizr sends questions (15-120 seconds max)
